title: Treaty of Baden (1714)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Baden (1714)", at revision 1336774671, opens: "The Treaty of Baden, signed 7 September 1714 in Baden, Switzerland, made peace between France and the Holy Roman Empire. Together with the Treaties of Utrecht and Rastatt, it was one in a series of agreements ending the 1701 to 1713 War of the Spanish Succession." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q688939, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty that ended formal hostilities between France and the Holy Roman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
